name: Owned checkpoint wait in worker resumption
summary: Owned work and the host resume queue expose bounded literal blocker/dependency text, source and next action from the exact caller's latest validated checkpoint. Exact actor attribution, historical/current status, review precedence, unknown histories, omission counts and escaped control text remain explicit. Missing person wording is never inferred. Reads acknowledge nothing and reuse the queue's linked checkpoint parse without another native query. The move sentence beside it in the same queue row quotes this wait in the checkpoint's own words and leaves the move open, so the two read as one thing.
